definitions.explanation: Failure to carry out a duty or obligation, especially one set out in a contract. Most often seen in the legal phrase {債務不履行|さいむふりこう} (default on an obligation).

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}の{不履行|ふりこう}。
{義務|ぎむ}の{不履行|ふりこう}で{訴|うった}えられた。
examples.english: He was sued for non-performance of his duty.

examples.japanese: {代金|だいきん}を{払|はら}わないのは{債務|さいむ}の{不履行|ふりこう}にあたる。
examples.english: Not paying the price constitutes a default on the obligation.

notes:
Formed from {不|ふ} (non-) + {履行|りこう} (performance, fulfillment). Mostly appears as the second half of a compound rather than standing alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {債務|さいむ}{不履行|ふりこう}: default on an obligation
- {契約|けいやく}{不履行|ふりこう}: breach of contract
- {不履行|ふりこう}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into default

REGISTER:
A formal legal and business term. In everyday speech, people say {約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}らない (not keep a promise) instead.
